entry.name: LET-Dex
entry.title: LET: Full-size humanoid robot real machine force and tactile dataset
entry.summary: Leju Kuavo 4 Pro humanoid with two Linker Hand L6 hands, each with five 12x6 fingertip taxel arrays (uint8) and a 6-axis force/torque stream, on 4 parcel-sorting and desk clean-up tasks, with head and wrist RGB-D, released as 714 ROS bags.
entry.hand: Linker Hand L6 (6 active + 5 passive joints) x 2 on Leju Kuavo 4 Pro

sensor.note: Per hand: /cb_<side>_hand_matrix_touch_pc2, a PointCloud2 of 360 uint8 values (field 'val'), 5 fingers x 12 rows x 6 columns, filled thumb to little finger; 255 = full pressure, 0 = none (card). Plus /force6d_<side>_hand_force_torque (WrenchStamped: force in N, torque in Nm, 30 Hz). Taxel values are raw; the wrench is in physical units but is a whole-hand reading, not per taxel.
sensor.model: Linker Hand L6 fingertip tactile matrix; 6-axis force/torque sensor (model and mount not stated)
sensor.range: taxels 0-255 raw; wrench range not stated

scale.text: 714 ROS bags (~7.8 h, 546 GB), 4 tasks: desk clean-up 301 bags / 4.4 h, SF Express parcel sorting 198 / 1.3 h, smart postal packages 121 / 0.55 h, 'Smartandfast-forward' 94 / 1.5 h; recorded 2025-12-18 and -19 on two robots

entry.access: Hugging Face LejuRobotics/LET-Dex-Dataset, ungated: 714 ROS1 bags (65 MB to 1.8 GB each) in 4 task folders. The ModelScope mirror lejurobot/LET-Dex-Dataset refused an anonymous file listing ('无权访问该数据集' [no permission to access this dataset]).
caveats: Tactile is sparse and low in the bags checked: in 3 bags (40-72 evenly spaced chunks each) the right-hand array read 0 in every sampled frame; left-hand contact showed on 1-2 fingers with taxel peaks of 22-83 of 255.
One clean-up bag (...-20251218150758-v001.bag) is truncated at 224 MiB: its header points to an index at 1.016 GB, past the end of the file. Another clean-up bag lasts 3.0 s.
The card describes per-bag label JSON files (scene, task, step marks with language); none are in the release, so the 4 folder names are the only task labels.

The card's topic tables also list gripper and simulation topics (/leju_claw_*, /gripper/*, /cmd_pose_world, /control_robot_hand_position, /dexhand/state) that do not occur in the tactile bags; the bags carry the 30 topics listed in the survey's channels.
Force/torque sensor placement not stated: the ROS frame is force6d_<side>_hand, the HF card calls it external force on the hand, the ModelScope text calls it fingertip force and torque.
Hand state runs 0-255 with 255 = open; a few hand_state messages carry 7 values instead of 6.
Teleoperation device per bag is not stated; the card lists the Linker TA arm exoskeleton, Linker TG glove and Linker FFG force-feedback glove.

Intel RealSense (model not stated; realsense2_camera driver metadata)

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LejuRobotics/LET-Dex-Dataset (README.md in Chinese, README_EN.md, API info, recursive tree)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/LejuRobotics/LET-Dex-Dataset bag headers and indexes of all 714 bags (HTTP range reads: first message time and last chunk-info end time)

https://huggingface.co/datasets/LejuRobotics/LET-Dex-Dataset .../Clean-up_desktop_items-P4-Linker_Hand_L6/A10-A12-H-C-05-TQ_02_01-p4_353-dex_hand-20251218112213-v001.bag (full index; 100 chunks: tactile, wrench, hand state, camera_info, images)
unconfirmed: hours = 7.8 derived from the bag indexes: first message time to last chunk end time, summed over 713 bags (the truncated bag has no index). Per task: 4.40 / 1.31 / 0.55 / 1.52 h; bag length 3.0-106.4 s (median 52.6 s clean-up, 23.1 s parcel sorting, 16.0 s postal, 56.2 s 'Smartandfast-forward').
Frame rate: cameras and wrench 30.0 Hz, tactile and hand state 29.6 Hz, hand commands 120 Hz, from message counts / bag duration in the clean-up bag.

Contact seen: parcel bag ...20251219114820 left thumb 6.4-9.9 s and 19.5-21.0 s (pad sum up to 86, taxel max 22); postal bag ...20251219163409 left middle pad 19 taxels summing 534-596 and ring 47-84 in every sampled frame for 21 s (held object or offset, not decided); clean-up bag ...20251218112213 non-zero in 1 of 72 sampled frames. Right hand 0 in all sampled frames of all three.
Finger order thumb to little is the card's statement; not checked against video.

scene_types from the ModelScope description ('快递包裹分拣、日化瓶翻面、家庭桌面整理' [express parcel sorting, flipping household-chemical bottles, home desk tidying]); bottle flipping has no folder of its own in the HF release.

Release size vs other counts: ModelScope says the first batch is '600余条' [600+ samples]; survey arXiv 2607.24744 lists LET-Dex as 3K episodes / 20 h / 14 tasks. The HF release has 714 bags / ~7.8 h / 4 task folders.
Two robots inferred from the device serials in file names (P4_338, p4_353); the card's label example uses deviceSn 'P4-209'.
Camera makers inferred from the driver metadata topic types (orbbec_camera/Metadata on /cam_h, realsense2_camera/Metadata on /cam_l, /cam_r); resolution 848x480 from camera_info and JPEG headers.

Sensing principle not stated by the release; the catalog's hardware entry linker_hand lists the 6x12 fingertip arrays as piezoresistive from the L20 / L20 Lite manuals, and says the SDK returns a 12x6 uint8 matrix per finger for the L6.

download.format: ROS1 bag v2.0, uncompressed chunks (~0.84 MB each, all topics interleaved): datasets/rosbag/tactile/real/Labelled/<task>/<code>-<robot>-dex_hand-<YYYYMMDDhhmmss>-v001.bag
download.per_episode: 65 MB to 1.8 GB per bag, ~20.5 MB per second of recording
download.partial_fetch: HTTP range reads: bag header + index (end of file) give topics, counts and chunk offsets; single chunks can be fetched, but tactile messages are interleaved with images, so the tactile of a whole episode costs about the whole bag

channels.shape: PointCloud2 height 1 x width 360, uint8 field 'val'
channels.frame: 5 fingers (thumb to little) x 12 rows x 6 columns
channels.note: frame_id empty; right hand 0 in every sampled frame of 3 bags

channels.note: |F| stayed between 4 and 11 N over the sampled postal bag, never near 0 (offset not removed); sensor mount not stated

channels.name: /kuavo_arm_traj

episodes.subject: robot P4_338, teleoperated
episodes.why: Contact checked on 45 evenly spaced chunks: left thumb pad non-zero 6.4-9.9 s and 19.5-21.0 s (pad sum up to 86). Right hand 0 throughout, as in every bag checked. 478 MB.

episodes.subject: robot P4_338, teleoperated
episodes.why: Candidate: left middle and ring pads non-zero in all 47 sampled frames (middle sum 534-596). Whether this is a held object or an offset must be checked in step 3; replace with another postal bag if the values never change with contact. 450 MB.

episodes.subject: robot p4_353, teleoperated
episodes.why: Candidate, contact not yet checked (median-length bag in 20-45 s). The one clean-up bag sampled (...112213, 57.5 s) had tactile in 1 of 72 sampled frames, so scan 2-3 bags. 853 MB.

episodes.subject: robot p4_353, teleoperated
episodes.why: Candidate, contact not yet checked; one of only 2 bags in this task between 20 and 45 s (63 of 94 are 10-60 s). 796 MB.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~2.6 GB for the 4 bags (478 + 450 + 853 + 796 MB); add ~1-2 GB if clean-up or 'Smartandfast-forward' candidates lack contact and need replacing. Tactile cannot be fetched without the interleaved images. Re-hosted media: head + one wrist JPEG stream re-encoded to H.264 848x480, ~10-20 MB per clip. Episode JSON: 2 x 360 uint8 at ~30 Hz x <= 45 s ~ 1M values, so store sparse or crop to the contact window.
sample.rules_applied: Tasks: 4 <= 6, so all 4. Episodes: one per task (4 > 3 tasks), 4 in total. Each must have both tactile topics present and contact above rest for >= 1 s; the right-hand arrays were 0 in every bag checked, so contact is judged on the hand that touches. Length 10-60 s (bags 3-106 s; all 4 picks within range). Budget: 2.6 GB of 20 GB.
